body:
So me and some amigos decided to abuse the 1P one night.  I had a vial and like an idiot I did this impulsively.  There were four of us tripping and it coincided with a UFC fight PPV.  We had a 30 pack of some domestic piss and I proceeded to puddle the four of us.
I was reasonably experienced and usually have very good experiences with LSD.  The other three were not so experienced.  Also my wife was there who was not dropping and another female friend of ours that us worked with.  I had forgotten the cardinal rule you take LSD not to escape but to confront.  Also always respect these chemical tools or you might get humbled.  Anyhow this vial of 1P was burning hole in my pocket so I gave each a full dropper of lysergic goodness.
I settled in to watch the fight and it was a good one but not for me.  The first thing that happened is these finely tuned athletes started to morph into pumas, or reptilian aliens.  I could see the energy behind every punch or kick in brilliant crimson.  If a fighter started bleeding it was like 3-D with the blood splattering through the screen in neon streaks of red orange and pink.  The violent aspect to the fights was highly unappealing.  Out of the four of us I was really the only one watching.
Two of the homies J and S were stepping out regularly to smoke cannabis.  S looked like his body was some impossible trapezoid not quite human hmm, I dont think Ill look over there anymore.  My other friend A who I was much closer with was in the tank the puddle hit him hard and he was wrenching for the first few hours.
My wife was acting strange and making me kind of uncomfortable not sure why.  So as these fights progress and I watch battered human after battered human it starts to negatively affect me.  We had brought our dogs over with us a beautiful brindle pitbull sweet as can be
and a three pound chi-chi
.  I guess they could sense my growing discomfort and they were glued to me
one at my feet and
the other in the crook of my right arm.
This is when the ego dissolution hit me I looked down and it appeared as if my Pit bull was my right leg and the chi-chi my right arm.  Our other female friend was sitting close to me on the couch which was odd I usually keep my distance from people (I have trust issues and trauma).  She appeared to be Emanating from my left side.  I was not in the head space to handle this level of dissolving and I freaked out.
Meanwhile my friend who was struggling physically was experiencing the most fantastic closed eye visuals.  In one he saw people planting trees and the seed was dollar bills.  Jesus came and tried to destroy the evil trees but they just planted more until the world was filled with these evil trees.
Since I was fighting my trip I went paranoid.  I started acting like an asshole and demanded that my wife take me home.  On the way to the car she handed me some Gatorade which had a lightening bolt on the bottle I started theorizing that we were actually droids and Gatorade would keep us fueled.  I cried out silently why God I dont wanna be an android.
When we got home I again was mean to my wife it wasnt her fault that Im fucking idiot.  Bless her heart she put on some cartoons The Emperors new Groove a decent Disney anime.  I started to chill slightly.  Then the thought entered my mind, Im in hell and this is it what is, it appears to be the real world but in fact is just a facsimile of earth and we continue to live in corrupt bodies.  This delusion continued for two weeks after the trip.
The cool thing about this as difficult as this experience was I consider it my best LSD experience
as difficult as this experience was I consider it my best LSD experience
.  I didnt realize how much my personal trauma was separating me from others and how scared I was to trust anyone.  I decided after two weeks of deep depression at my hellish revelation that even if that was true I was gonna live to the fullest in hell or otherwise.  I got my spiritual life sorted out Im a Christian today, I stopped drinking and Im in therapy.  Lucy was trying to help me heal but I resisted.  It probably would have gone better with a little care taken to have a better setting but honestly I wouldnt change a thing. A hard head makes a soft behind and because of the love of friends and family I didnt do anything to life wrecking.
